title: network
description: Extra network settings of the main NIC of a VM (D-294, D-332, D-348 … D-350): extra addresses, routes, name servers and search domains. VM only: Proxmox owns the network of a container. The main address, the gateway and DHCP stay as cloud-init made them (create-only). The agent writes one file /etc/netplan/60-plumb-<name>.yaml (0600) with only these values, under the netplan key of the main NIC (the ethernets entry that holds the main address in the merged netplan get view, eth0 on a Plumb VM), and runs netplan apply inside the safe apply (D-293, D-333). Before any change it checks the merged result in a temporary root (netplan get --root-dir): the main address, gateway, match and set-name must be unchanged and every value of this resource present, else the step fails with nothing changed. Observe: the file and the live state (ip -j addr, ip -j route, resolvectl); a listed address, route, name server or search domain that is missing live is drift; other live values are not Plumb's. Needs netplan with the networkd backend (Debian 13 and Ubuntu 26.04 cloud images have it). Risk: create, change and absent disruptive. Absent removes the file and runs netplan apply in the safe apply.

name.description: Key; part of the file name. Several network resources on one Target add up; they must not repeat a value of each other.

addresses.description: Extra addresses on the main NIC, comma separated, with prefix, for example 192.0.2.10/24,2001:db8::10/64. Never the main address of the Target (the server and the agent refuse it), never a link-local address.

routes.description: Routes over the main NIC, ';' separated, each '<cidr> via <ip>[ metric <n>]', for example 198.51.100.0/24 via 192.0.2.1. No default route (0.0.0.0/0, ::/0): the gateway stays create-only. The via address must be in a network of the main NIC (main or extra address); the agent checks it in the temporary root.

nameservers.description: Extra DNS servers for the main NIC, comma separated IPs. They come after the servers that cloud-init set (netplan appends).

search.description: Extra DNS search domains, comma separated.
